newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIA falls four pct as interims disappoint.
newsitem.headline: SIA falls four pct as interims disappoint.

text.p: Shares in national carrier Singapore Airlines Ltd opened 60 Singapore cents, or four percent, lower on Monday after the group reported a disappointing set of half-year results.
SIA's foreign share tranche, most closely followed by fund managers, stood at Singapore $13.40 by 0105 GMT, against Friday's close of S$14.00.
Earlier on Monday, SIA reported a bottom-of-consensus 7.2 percent rise in net profit to S$560.5 million for the six months to September 30, 1996.
Its operating profit fell 11.4 percent to S$467.6 million, reflecting a fall in yields.
The net result was only saved by the sale of aircraft and spares which produced a gain of S$122.7 million against only S$14.7 million the year before.
